## Completion Report: Work Order 4 — Index Migration (`pr-07-v2-storage-wo4`)

### Status
Completed

### Changes Made

- **Schema Migration** in [`internal/core/index/index.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/index.go#L49-L145):
  - Retained `episodes_fts`, `entities`, and `entity_relations` tables for backward compatibility.
  - Added v2 schema tables:
    - `entries`: Primary storage for entries (`id`, `type`, `dossier_scope`, `text`, `source`, `verified`, `closes_when`, `created_at`, `updated_at`).
    - `entries_fts`: FTS5 external content table referencing `entries(rowid)` with insert/delete/update triggers (`entries_ai`, `entries_ad`, `entries_au`).
    - `entry_anchors`: Anchor mappings with `idx_entry_anchors_anchor` index and foreign key cascade to `entries(id)`.
    - `error_patterns`: Command error patterns referencing `entries(id)`.
    - `aliases`: Dossier scope redirection mapping (`old_scope`, `new_scope`, `created_at`).
    - `entry_history`: Retired and superseded entry snapshots.
- **Entry CRUD & FTS5** in [`internal/core/index/entries.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go):
  - [`UpsertEntry`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L38-L96): Inserts or updates entries, synchronizing entry anchors within a write transaction.
  - [`GetEntry`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L99-L141): Fetches and hydrates an entry by ID; returns [`ErrNotFound`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L15) when missing.
  - [`DeleteEntry`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L144-L157): Deletes an entry and associated anchors and error patterns (triggers FTS5 removal).
  - [`ListEntriesByScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L160-L215): Lists all hydrated entries under a dossier scope.
  - [`SearchEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L218-L279): Executes full-text search against `entries_fts` ordered by BM25 relevance.
  - [`InsertErrorPattern`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L290-L297) & [`LookupErrorPatterns`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L300-L336): Manages and matches command prefix failure patterns.
  - [`UpsertAlias`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L339-L352) & [`ResolveAlias`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L355-L383): Records scope alias redirects and resolves alias chains with cycle and depth (max 10) guards.
  - [`InsertHistory`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L386-L415) & [`GetHistory`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entries.go#L418-L450): Persists and queries historical entry revisions.
- **Anchor Lookups** in [`internal/core/index/entry_anchors.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entry_anchors.go):
  - [`UpsertEntryAnchors`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entry_anchors.go#L11-L40): Atomically replaces all anchors for a given entry.
  - [`LookupByAnchor`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entry_anchors.go#L43-L70): Prefix search over anchors using `LIKE ?%`.
  - [`LookupByAnchorExact`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/entry_anchors.go#L73-L95): Exact matching over anchors.
- **Op Log Rebuild** in [`internal/core/index/rebuild.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/rebuild.go#L15-L129):
  - [`RebuildFromOpLog`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/rebuild.go#L15-L129): Projects dossiers from op log via `dossiers.NewProjector(opsReader).Project(ctx)`, clears v2 index tables in a transaction, rebuilds `entries`, `entry_anchors`, `error_patterns`, `entry_history`, `entries_fts`, and populates aliases from `config.BuildAliasMap`.
- **Test Suite** in [`internal/core/index/v2_test.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/index/v2_test.go):
  - Added test coverage verifying FTS search over rebuilt entries alongside entry CRUD, FTS5 queries, anchor prefix & exact matching, error pattern lookups, alias resolution chains, history, and end-to-end op log rebuilding.
